svg.text: The Taskify system (process 0 on the context diagram) broken into its main processes. Each row is one process with everything it exchanges data with.
Outside entities are on the left (people) and right (services); data stores are on the right.
read and write (two flows drawn as one line)
A store with an extra stripe, or an entity with a
corner mark, is a repeat of one drawn above.
D1 Users & security: users, trusted_devices, security_events, admin_allowlist
D2 Listings, offers & transactions: tasks, sales_items, equipment, events, event_rsvps, offers, offer_history, payments, sale_orders, equipment_bookings, booking_extensions
D6 Reports & moderation: reports, blocked_content_attempts, flagged_uploads
Payments are a demo: "payment" flows record statuses (held, released, refunded) — no money moves and no payment provider is connected.
Process 4 also expires lapsed booking requests and approvals; it runs whenever rentals are viewed and from the same 15-minute timed job that triggers process 6's reminders.
Process names list the backend services that implement them (backend/src/services). Generated by docs/diagrams/build-dfd.js from the same flow list as the Level 0 diagram.
